newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras October inflation 1.5 pct--central bank.
newsitem.headline: Honduras October inflation 1.5 pct--central bank.

text.p: Inflation in October was 1.5 percent, the lowest level in the last seven months, the central bank said.
Accumulated inflation for 1996 to the end of October was 21.6 percent.
In October last year inflation was 1.9 percent.
Most of the increase in October this year came in education, reading and leisure, transportation and housing costs, the central bank said.
In September the consumer price index rose 1.7 percent.
The government has an inflation target of 16 percent for the year.
